caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted eagle with its wings spread wide, perched atop a spherical object that is placed on a rectangular, wood-textured base. The eagle is primarily colored in shades of brown and yellow, with darker brown shading under its wings and on the feather details. Its beak and the highlights of its head are a lighter cream color, and its eye is depicted with a small red dot. The spherical object the eagle stands on is colored a yellowish tone, matching the bird, and has some rounded, protruding features. The base is colored in reddish-brown, mimicking the appearance of wood, and features a circular hole on its front face. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are a few small brownish spots to the left of the eagle.
title: Flag Pole Holder
